item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find evidence in the sources reviewed of a Marcos-ordered nationwide internet shutdown in 2024, a clear mass surveillance program aimed at political opponents, or a new, formal, Philippines-wide digital blackout policy. What I did find is a narrower pattern: preexisting site blocks, red-tagging, libel/threat pressure, and continued digital control measures, alongside connectivity-building and anti-disinformation steps.","evidence":[{"title":"PBBM ushers Filipinos to a better, brighter, more connected “Bagong Pilipinas” with the “Philippine Domestic Submarine Cable Network” launch","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"February 15, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-ushers-filipinos-to-a-better-brighter-more-connected-bagong-pilipinas-with-the-philippine-domestic-submarine-cable-network-launch/","summary":"Marcos framed the PDSCN as expanding reliable, affordable internet and digital connectivity. This cuts against a finding of broad internet suppression.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.6"]},{"title":"PBBM orders connectivity in remote, isolated communities","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"September 9, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/pbbm-orders-connectivity-in-remote-isolated-communities/","summary":"Marcos directed DICT to expand connectivity and free Wi-Fi in remote areas. This is pro-access, not digital repression.","question_ids":["4B.9","4B.6"]},{"title":"Gov’t vows legal action vs deep fake video creators, spreaders","publisher":"Presidential Communications Office","date":"April 26, 2024","url":"https://pco.gov.ph/news_releases/govt-vows-legal-action-vs-deep-fake-video-creators-spreaders/","summary":"The government responded to a manipulated video with investigation and possible legal action through DICT and NSC.
